about: The earlier public keys of incident.flights@web-summit.dinis (handed over, ended or not used), oldest first: moved here from data/keys.json, whose in-use keys stay there. Public halves only. Read every key with tools/lane-keystore.mjs.

keys.role: Flights on the map with the wind: METAR crosswind per runway joined to departures, the Open-Meteo wind field, airline aircraft snapshots from OpenSky, as replayable JSON (incidents/*/data/flights/).
keys.how: Made in its own session on 11 November 2026, 22:02 UTC (pki-agent.mjs keygen --session, the copy whose sha256 is fcb28a1c...02ab, checked before it ran). The first flights session. A session key: it ends with the session. It handed over to the second session at 23:04 UTC on 11 November and its key ended with it.

keys.role: Flights on the map with the wind: METAR crosswind per runway joined to departures, the Open-Meteo wind field, de-identified airline aircraft snapshots from adsb.lol (ODbL), as replayable JSON (incidents/*/data/flights/).
keys.how: Made in its own session on 11 November 2026, 23:03 UTC (pki-agent.mjs keygen --session, the copy whose sha256 is fcb28a1c...02ab, checked before it ran). The second flights session, started from agents/flights/HANDOVER.md. A session key: it ends with the session. It handed over to the third session at 00:03 UTC on 12 November and its key ended with it.
